# Golabs

> Golabs is a nearshore AI and tech talent provider from LATAM offering custom AI solutions, machine learning services, and staff augmentation for US enterprises.

Based in Costa Rica, Golabs specializes in connecting businesses with vetted AI engineers and ML talent while delivering enterprise-grade solutions in artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud computing, and DevOps. The company serves as a strategic nearshore development partner for companies seeking to scale their technical capabilities with Latin American talent.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence
- Machine Learning

- AI Consulting
